answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable work bond of 1,000 POA before it may take paid tasks, with the bond slashed if peers prove fraud. An attacker spinning up 500 fake identities must freeze 500,000 POA and still pass 25 verified paid jobs per identity, so the cost of one fake vertex in the trust graph exceeds any single payout. The velvet glove is the refund: honest agents get the bond back, so the barrier is a fable only for cheats, not a tax on real work.
